subject: general
question:
Which figure from the given option would replace the question mark (?) if the following figure series were to be continued?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7683706e42defde5b87254ccb64cf00fb7b8943044af8f3d246d60a40a9896d1.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is,

Logic:** "T" is interchanging its position between 4th and 5th and "L" is interchanging its position between 1st and 2nd in the subsequent term of the series.**

**"S" is moving one position in a forward direction in the subsequent term of the series.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a312811ea24623b36c63a4fd17e97f3d09621b7cae2cacbc851ccd9de4ad32db.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d32e437e5c43b9bb8ee68167d198c86ed2b7b613ca510f5951cc2a97a1d849dd.png]
